# Locked Python packages for the agent service container.
#
# Every package, including the packages they depend on, is pinned to an exact
# version and to its published fingerprints (SHA-256 hashes). The image build
# runs 'pip install --require-hashes', so a package that has been tampered with
# upstream is refused instead of installed. This protects the delivery pipeline
# against tampered packages (supply chain risk).
#
# The packages chosen directly are:
#   fastapi==0.143.0
#   uvicorn==0.54.0
#   httpx==0.28.1
#   pydantic==2.14.0
#   langgraph==1.2.14
#   weaviate-client==4.23.1
#   fastembed==0.9.0
#   pypdf==6.20.0
#   opentelemetry-api==1.45.1
#   opentelemetry-sdk==1.45.1
#   opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http==1.45.1
#
# To update, save those lines as requirements.in, change a version, then run:
#   pip install pip-tools
#   pip-compile --generate-hashes --allow-unsafe --strip-extras requirements.in -o requirements.txt
# using Python 3.12 on Linux (for example inside the python:3.12-slim image).
